text.translation: Sanpei: Kyouji!{n}When I heard you were dead,{n}I was really shocked.

text.reference: なにせ、ヤバい仕事をやっつけられるのは{n}おまえだけだからな。
text.translation: After all, you're the only one{n}who can handle the dangerous jobs.

text.reference: そうそう、最近、市立病院の友人に頼まれて{n}原因不明の病気ってヤツにかかった青年を{n}診にいったんだが、
text.translation: Oh, right. A friend at the city hospital{n}recently asked me to examine a young man{n}with some strange, unexplained illness,

text.reference: 結局、俺にも分からずじまいだった…。{WAIT}{n}キョウジ、おまえが追っかけてる仕事と{n}何か関係あるのか？
text.translation: but even I couldn't figure it out...{WAIT}{n}Kyouji, could it have anything to do with{n}the case you're working on?

text.reference: とにかくだ、いいかキョウジ！{n}傷を負ったら、無理をしないで{n}俺のところへ戻って来い。分かったな！
text.translation: Anyway, listen, Kyouji!{n}If you get hurt, don't push yourself.{n}Come straight back here. Got it?!

text.reference: 三平：キョウジ、あまり無理をするなよ！{n}いいか、これは友人としての忠告だからな！
text.translation: Sanpei: Kyouji, don't push yourself too hard!{n}I'm telling you this as a friend!
